summary: The StudentTrainingPrograms module handles the management and maintenance of training programs for students. It includes functionality for adding, updating, and searching student training program details.
purpose: To manage student training program records, including adding, updating, inactivating, and searching details relevant to student programs.

workflows.name: Add Student Training Program
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, StudentID, ProgramID, StageCodeID, AgencyID, StartDate, EndDate, Comments

workflows.name: Update Student Training Program
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, ID, ProgramID, StageCodeID, AgencyID, StartDate, EndDate, Comments

workflows.name: Search Student Training Program by ID
steps: Read data and populate StudentTrainingProgram entity
Return list of student training programs

business_rules: Comments field in uxDetail should not exceed 1000 characters.
Inactivate student training program when command is deactivate.
validations: Ensure SessionID, StudentID, and other required fields are provided before executing database procedures.
Check date fields for valid dates using DateFormatter.ParseDate.
calculations: StartDateFormatted and EndDateFormatted are derived using DateFormatter.FormatDateShort.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is checked to enable or disable edit functionalities.
system_behavior: Auto-generate form fields and link buttons using ASP.NET controls.
UpdatePanel or ModalPopupExtender used for UI interactions.
FormViewMode is used to determine UI control states (Insert, Edit, ReadOnly).
exceptions: Cancel operation if Session is null during data source selection.
